_comment: Source of truth for api/tests/test_prompt_version_enforcement.py. Every entry's hash MUST equal the current SHA-256 (first 16 hex chars) of that component's rendered prompt (forecaster.py's GATEKEEPER_PROMPT_HASH/EXTRACTOR_PROMPT_HASH). Whenever a prompt-text edit changes model behavior materially: bump the matching *_PROMPT_VERSION constant in forecaster.py, add a row to docs/PROMPT_VERSIONS.md, and update this file's version+hash to match. The test fails otherwise.
